name: Karen
site: sixt.com · Car rental and subscriptions, Germany
headline: Turn Sixt’s booking data into repeat rentals that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells car rental deals, the SIXT+ Car Subscription, SIXT Business and SIXT ONE rewards to every visitor the same way, whether they come to book a weekend trip or run a fleet.

Once a renter has an account, rental history, return locations and SIXT ONE rewards activity are the strongest signal for the next upgrade or lapse. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Upsell and anti churn campaigns for SIXT+ subscriptions and business accounts are built by hand, per segment, per month. The renter who is about to lapse this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapse before it happens
cases.text: Per renter lapse signals from booking frequency, rental gaps, app activity and SIXT ONE engagement. The right offer, channel and moment for each customer, tested across SIXT+ and business accounts.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match the right plan to each renter
cases.text: Next best plan, add-on or business offer per customer, triggered by how they actually rent. SIXT+ upsell for frequent renters, and no blanket mails to people already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every renter coming back
cases.text: Personal reminders and offers in app, push and email, built around each renter’s bookings and SIXT ONE rewards. Every customer gets a reason to book again.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
